scope: primary OSA full-grid availability, all4reported policies,2strata,5cutoffs,200replicate seeds
efficacy_gap: maximum true efficacy over truly acceptable25grid doses minus true efficacy at selectedgrid dose
denominator: all initiated full-grid stratum trials; retain every fallback, filter neither by posterior criterion nor by outcomes
